text:
🚀 TKR-H7 UPSCALE — DISTRIBUTED WING POWER, MICRO-THRUST & KINETIC RECOVERY
TECH TREASURES ZA | NEANDERTHALISM 2.0
THE SKY IS JUST THE NEXT LANE.
DISCOVER. ENGINEER. RECOVER. EVOLVE.
What happens when we stop thinking of an aircraft as a body with two engines attached, and start thinking of it as an integrated network of aerodynamic surfaces, distributed propulsion modules, electrical storage, intelligent power management and recoverable energy?

That is the question behind the evolving TKR-H7 Upscale concept.

This is our exploration of a modular, electrically powered cargo aircraft that preserves its original identity: the long pointed nose, broad cranked-delta-inspired wings, twin large ducted fans, central glowing kinetic core, solar-integrated surfaces, reinforced structural battery spine and interchangeable cargo pod.

But now the wings become far more than lifting surfaces.

They become an integrated engineering platform.

⚙️ 1. THE WING INTAKE ARRAY — EVERY OPENING MUST EARN ITS PLACE

Imagine disciplined rows of small, precision-engineered intake nozzles integrated into selected sections of both wings.

From the outside, these look like miniature aerodynamic ports arranged along the wing leading edges and carefully chosen upper-surface locations. Inside, each module could contain an inlet duct, a fan or rotor, an electric motor-generator where appropriate, electrical connections, temperature sensors, power electronics and a controlled airflow outlet.

The objective is not to fill the wings with glowing holes for visual effect.

The objective is to determine whether carefully distributed airflow devices can provide useful thrust, help manage local airflow, improve control options or recover energy in selected operating conditions.

We are investigating three distinct functions.

🔵 MODE A — ELECTRIC MICRO-THRUST

Air enters a duct, an electrically driven fan transfers energy to the airflow, and the accelerated air produces a reaction force.

The basic momentum relationship is:

F = ṁ(Vexit − Vinlet) + (Pexit − Pambient)Aexit

Here, ṁ is mass flow rate, V represents airflow velocity, P represents pressure and Aexit is the outlet area.

This relationship reminds us that thrust depends on how much air we move, how much we change its velocity and the relevant pressure forces.

A series of smaller fans could potentially provide distributed control authority, supplementary thrust or assistance during selected phases of flight.

However, eight, twelve or twenty small fans do not automatically outperform two larger fans. Smaller units may incur greater relative tip losses, duct friction, motor overhead, cooling demands, electrical complexity and maintenance requirements.

Our question is simple:

Can strategically positioned micro-thrusters improve the complete aircraft enough to justify their mass, power consumption and complexity?

The answer must come from calculations and experiments.

🟠 MODE B — ACTIVE WING AIRFLOW MANAGEMENT

The second possibility involves using selected inlets, internal passages and controlled outlets to interact with airflow close to the aircraft's surface.

This opens a research path into boundary-layer ingestion, suction, blowing and flow re-energisation.

Near a wing surface, airflow loses momentum because of viscosity. Under some conditions, managing that boundary layer can influence separation, pressure distribution and aerodynamic losses.

But the engineering challenge is substantial.

Moving air through the aircraft requires power. Internal ducts cause losses. Inlets and outlets can disturb surrounding airflow. Equipment occupying the wing reduces available structural volume and may complicate maintenance.

The meaningful test is whether a proposed system reduces total aircraft energy demand after including the power consumed by the airflow-management equipment.

If it consumes more power than it saves, we redesign it or remove it.

No magic. No free thrust. Just engineering.

⚡ MODE C — RAM-AIR ENERGY RECOVERY

Now we investigate the recovery side.

A turbine placed in an airflow can drive a generator and return electrical energy to the aircraft's power system.

During descent, some gravitational potential energy can be converted into electrical energy while the aircraft loses altitude. During other phases, a turbine can extract energy from the airflow, but that extraction produces drag and changes the aircraft's energy budget.

That means we must distinguish two operating situations.

First, recovering a portion of energy during a descent where energy management makes recovery useful.

Second, deliberately operating a turbine during level flight, where the aircraft must overcome the additional drag.

The second arrangement can easily consume more propulsion energy than the turbine returns.

A ram-air turbine is therefore a potential recovery device, not an additional free propulsion source.

Our concept must allow the controller to decide whether recovery is worthwhile under the current flight conditions.

🔧 2. CAN ONE MODULE DO THREE JOBS?

We propose investigating a modular wing unit with three possible operating modes:

1️⃣ Propulsion mode: an electric motor drives a fan to produce thrust.

2️⃣ Airflow-management mode: a controlled fan or duct modifies local airflow where a measurable aerodynamic benefit may exist.

3️⃣ Recovery mode: a suitably configured turbine-generator extracts energy from an available airflow, subject to its drag penalty.

One possible research direction is a reversible fan-generator assembly.

Another is to separate the propulsion fans from the recovery turbines so that each can be optimised for its own purpose.

The reversible option may reduce duplicated equipment, but changing operating modes could require suitable rotor design, flow routing, variable geometry, control electronics and carefully engineered operating limits.

The separate-unit approach may be easier to optimise aerodynamically but could add substantial mass and complexity.

We should compare both architectures before selecting the first prototype.

🔋 3. THE ELECTRICAL POWER SPINE

The aircraft needs a clearly defined electrical architecture connecting every energy source and consumer.

Our proposed system includes:

• Solar photovoltaic skin integrated into suitable wing and fuselage surfaces.

• A primary battery system with battery-management, monitoring and protective isolation.

• A high-voltage DC distribution bus.

• Dedicated inverters and motor controllers for the twin main ducted fans.

• Separate drive electronics for distributed wing microfans.

• Optional turbine-generator modules with appropriate rectification and power conversion.

• A central TKR kinetic-storage interface.

• Cooling systems for motors, inverters, electrical conductors and high-power storage equipment.

• Flight-control systems capable of monitoring distributed propulsion, detecting failures and managing safe operating limits.

• Protected electrical connectors and service interfaces for the modular cargo pod.

The architecture must account for actual voltage, current, cable mass, electrical resistance, thermal limits, transient power demand and fault isolation.

The aim is to make the aircraft's subsystems work together rather than treating every component as a separate invention.

🔵 4. THE TKR KINETIC CORE — STORE, BUFFER, RELEASE

At the centre of the aircraft sits our proposed TKR flywheel energy-storage module.

The principle is established physics.

A rotating mass stores kinetic energy:

E = ½Iω²

Where E is stored energy, I is the rotor's moment of inertia and ω is its angular velocity in radians per second.

The kinetic core would use a flywheel rotor, motor-generator, bearings, containment, vibration monitoring and a dedicated control system.

When energy is available from an external charging source or a suitable recovery process, the motor-generator can accelerate the rotor and store energy mechanically.

Later, the rotor can slow down while delivering part of that stored energy back through the motor-generator.

This could provide short-duration power buffering during a transient demand, depending on the system's demonstrated energy capacity, output rating and conversion efficiency.

Counter-rotating flywheels are another possible design direction because a properly balanced pair can reduce the net gyroscopic angular momentum.

However, counter-rotation does not cancel the energy-storage requirement, remove bearing friction or eliminate the need for rotor containment.

High-speed rotating machinery introduces serious engineering challenges: rotor fatigue, vibration, bearing failure, overspeed, thermal management and containment of a failed rotor.

The kinetic core therefore remains a proposed subsystem until its geometry, material properties, operating speed and safety envelope have been calculated and independently reviewed.

The guiding principle is that the flywheel shifts energy through time. It does not generate unlimited energy.

☀️ 5. SOLAR SKIN — ANOTHER CONTRIBUTION, NOT A MIRACLE

Solar cells integrated into suitable wing and fuselage surfaces could contribute to onboard electrical generation.

Their output depends on effective cell area, solar irradiance, conversion efficiency, orientation, temperature, shading and electrical losses.

We must also consider the aircraft's actual usable surface area and the added mass of the photovoltaic system, wiring, power electronics and protective layers.

Solar electricity could support selected onboard loads and contribute to the electrical energy budget.

But the available solar area may be far too small to sustain the complete propulsion system continuously, especially during demanding flight operations.

That is why we must calculate realistic generation figures rather than simply assign impressive kilowatt ratings to the wings.

🌐 6. FOUR WING CONFIGURATIONS TO INVESTIGATE

CONFIGURATION A — SINGLE ROW

One carefully positioned row of powered microfan modules per wing.

This is the simplest initial study, with fewer components and comparatively lower integration complexity.

CONFIGURATION B — STAGGERED MICRO-THRUST ARRAY

Two staggered rows of smaller modules.

Potentially greater flexibility in airflow management and thrust distribution, but with more electrical connections, more internal volume requirements and more failure points.

CONFIGURATION C — LEADING-EDGE INTAKES PLUS LARGER FANS

A limited number of appropriately sized powered modules combined with leading-edge airflow-management features.

This may offer a more practical balance between thrust, efficiency, structural space and serviceability.

CONFIGURATION D — SEPARATE PROPULSION AND RECOVERY SYSTEMS

Retain the twin main ducted fans and introduce a limited number of supplementary wing propulsion modules, with separately deployable or selectively operated ram-air recovery equipment.

This is our leading architectural candidate for investigation because it separates the jobs and makes energy flows easier to measure.

All four configurations must fit inside a credible wing geometry without compromising primary structural spars, control surfaces, thermal-management routes or safe maintenance access.

No module count is final until the available volume, installed power, mass and aerodynamic consequences have been studied.

🚚 7. MODULAR CARGO — THE AIRCRAFT CHANGES, THE POD STAYS

The TKR-H7 concept continues the modular logistics principle developed across our TKR ecosystem.

The aircraft is designed around an interchangeable cargo pod concept, with potential variants for lighter utility cargo, medium freight and heavier loads.

A standardised pod interface could eventually support common handling practices across compatible ground transport and airborne platforms.

However, the aircraft, cargo pod and docking interface must be engineered together.

Payload capacity is not simply the mass that physically fits underneath the fuselage. We must establish maximum take-off mass, centre of gravity, structural load limits, cargo restraint, landing loads, power requirements and the effect of the payload on flight performance.

Our existing design-board figures are preliminary concept targets, not validated aircraft capabilities.

The same applies to proposed range, cruise speed, solar output and energy-storage capacity.

Every number must survive engineering analysis before it becomes a performance claim.

🧮 8. THE PHYSICS AUDIT — WHERE THE NUMBERS MUST EARN THEIR PLACE

The aircraft's energy budget must distinguish:

Energy supplied: external charging and solar generation.

Energy stored: battery electrochemical energy and flywheel rotational energy.

Energy consumed: propulsion, avionics, cooling, pumps, communications and other onboard loads.

Energy recovered: a fraction of available braking or descent-related energy, subject to conversion efficiency and operating conditions.

Energy lost: aerodynamic drag, turbulence, electrical resistance, motor losses, duct friction, heat, bearing friction and power-electronics losses.

The total system must be evaluated as a whole.

A turbine may recover electricity while increasing drag. A microfan may improve control while increasing electrical demand. A flywheel may reduce a short power peak while adding mass and containment requirements.

A component is useful only when its contribution to the complete mission justifies its costs.

This is how we distinguish an attractive visual idea from a practical engineering development.

🛡️ 9. FAILURE MANAGEMENT AND SAFETY

A distributed propulsion aircraft needs robust responses to:

• Asymmetric thrust caused by a failed or obstructed fan.

• Inlet blockage, foreign-object damage and internal debris.

• Electrical bus faults, short circuits and inverter failures.

• Motor and power-electronics overheating.

• Unintended turbine deployment or excessive drag.

• Flywheel overspeed, rotor imbalance and containment failure.

• Battery thermal events.

• Sensor, control-computer or communication failures.

• Structural compromises caused by wing-mounted equipment.

The architecture should investigate modular isolation, redundant monitoring where justified, safe shutdown modes, protected electrical routing, suitable rotor containment and independently verified flight-control responses.

No full-scale flight should be attempted on the strength of a concept drawing alone.

🧪 10. THE PROTOTYPE ROADMAP

STAGE 1 — ONE MODULE ON A TEST BENCH

Measure electrical input, airflow, fan speed, thrust, temperature and output power.

Test the unit as a powered fan and, where the hardware permits, as a generator. Compare the energy entering and leaving the system.

STAGE 2 — WING-SECTION TEST

Build a representative section containing the proposed inlet, duct, fan and outlet arrangement.

Investigate airflow distribution, pressure losses, structural integration and interaction between neighbouring modules.

STAGE 3 — WIND-TUNNEL VALIDATION

Measure the effects on drag, lift, boundary-layer behaviour and the total power required to achieve any claimed aerodynamic improvement.

STAGE 4 — INTEGRATED ELECTRICAL TEST

Connect representative propulsion modules, power electronics, battery simulation and the proposed kinetic buffer.

Record power flow, conversion efficiency, thermal performance and fault responses.

STAGE 5 — SUBSCALE FLIGHT DEMONSTRATOR

Only after successful analysis and ground testing should a carefully controlled subscale aircraft be considered, with an appropriate safety and flight-test programme.

STAGE 6 — REASSESS THE FULL H7

Use measured results to update the mass budget, power architecture, aerodynamic model, mission profile and realistic performance targets.

🏴‍☠️ THE NEANDERTHALISM 2.0 PHILOSOPHY

We are not trying to make an aircraft that cheats physics.

We are trying to ask better questions about how the pieces could work together.

Can distributed electric propulsion provide useful supplementary control? Can carefully designed wing airflow management earn back the power it consumes? Can solar generation contribute meaningfully? Can selected recovery systems reclaim energy that would otherwise be lost? Can a kinetic core buffer short peaks without becoming an unacceptable burden?

Those are real engineering questions.

Our task is to develop the concepts, identify the constraints, measure the results and improve the design.

THE CURRENT LEADING CONCEPT

Preserve the original TKR-H7 Upscale aircraft.

Retain the twin main ducted fans for primary propulsion.

Investigate a limited number of reversible wing fan-generator modules for supplementary thrust and carefully selected recovery functions.

Keep ram-air turbines as a separate recovery option unless an integrated design demonstrates a clear advantage.

Investigate a properly contained central TKR flywheel as a short-duration power buffer.

Develop the entire energy architecture around a measured power budget, a realistic aerodynamic model and verified safety requirements.

This is a concept-development programme, not a claim that a flight-ready aircraft or unlimited-energy system already exists.

TECH TREASURES ZA | TITAN KINETIC RECOVERY

DISCOVER. ENGINEER. RECOVER. EVOLVE.
The sky is just the next lane.

text:
The lazy "CIA did it" argument currently being aggressively championed by David Hundeyin and his Spearhead team as the ultimate, all-encompassing framework to explain our present political decay and socio-economic woes is ultimately invalid, and completely breaks down in the face of even the most rudimentary, basic application of common sense. 

Of course, this is not to say that all our problems are completely localized, self-inflicted, or that there is no form of foreign interference, imperialist meddling, and covert sabotage in our politics and governance. 
In fact, I myself have written dozens of articles indicating, exposing, and directly implicating CIA interference in our academic institutions, our media houses, our civil society organizations, and our political space. I have also written extensively, and unapologetically about Western-backed assassinations, and the brutal economic structures such as predatory IMF debts, rigged World Trade Organization treaties, and suffocating structural adjustment programs that were deliberately put in place to facilitate the neocolonial extraction of African wealth, solid minerals, and human resources. 

However, these essays of mine should be viewed first and foremost as a vital historical lesson, because I firmly believe it is completely impossible to achieve genuine political consciousness, or strategic foresight without a solid grounding in history. 
Secondly, apart from serving as a historical record, I present them strictly as a materialist thesis to explain exactly how global capital interacts with the Global South, how multinational cartels operate, and the extreme, violent measures taken by global empires to preserve the political and economic configurations that facilitate the extraction of wealth from the bleeding interior to the wealthy periphery. I do not present them as an unquestionable religious dogma, neither do I pretend to showcase them as the one and only roadmap toward understanding the complex, multi-layered political climate of Nigeria in particular and Africa in general. 

Indeed, one simply cannot pretend that our local leaders are mindless, helpless puppets without cognitive agency who are merely acting on the direct, robotic orders and mandates of their masters in Western capitals. If a corrupt politician in Nigeria ruthlessly loots billions of dollars reserved for national electricity grids, public hospitals, and primary schools, and instead diverts that stolen money into purchasing luxury real estate portfolios in Dubai, buying private jets, acquiring offshore trust funds, and hoarding exotic cars under his family name, while at the exact same time signing away multi-billion-dollar mineral contracts to American defense contractors just to politically protect his regime, then that person has officially ceased to be a mere puppet. His status ultimately, undeniably upgrades to that of a ruthless colonial governor, a willing comprador elite, and a highly active participant in the exact same global capitalist system keeping his own people perpetually poor, starving, and subjugated. 

This is the exact same logic the Chinese ultimately used to survive the devastating Opium Wars and reclaim their sovereignty. The greedy Chinese merchants and local warlords who were actively smuggling toxic drugs from British ships into the inland provinces of China were not treated as mindless, innocent puppets without any form of agency. They were treated first and foremost as the primary targets, the domestic enemies, and the willing, blood-soaked collaborators of Western imperialism. 

Furthermore, even if we completely surrendered all forms of logical reasoning, abandoned our intellect, and succumbed to David Hundeyin's relentless online harassment and lazy insistence that the "CIA did it" every single time a pothole appears on the road, this argument still spectacularly breaks down. It fails because the narrative is being deceptively presented as if merely removing foreign interference, closing Western embassies, and kicking out foreign spies would suddenly, magically lead to our total economic liberation. In brutal reality, Nigeria is so deeply, structurally embedded into global capitalism that even if the IMF permanently shut down its Abuja office today, the greedy Black billionaires, local banking cartels, and corporate oligarchs in Africa would happily open a brand-new, indigenous exploitation office the very next morning to enslave their own people in predatory debt just to increase their own profit margins. With or without the direct, visible colonial structure of extraction, I do not see any serious, materialist analysis that can ever guarantee the economic freedom, human dignity, and survival of the poor working-class masses in Nigeria without a complete systemic overhaul, a radical psychological realignment, and a highly disciplined mass revolutionary campaign. 

Even the romanticized military coup that David Hundeyin is recklessly championing as the only viable solution is still a fundamentally extractive, oppressive, and capitalist system. The incoming military generals and the khaki-wearing dictators will ultimately, inevitably enrich their own inner circles, award bloated defense contracts to their cronies, and loot state resources with absolute impunity under the banner of "Pan-Africanism", exactly as the civilian political class is currently doing under this rotten, democratic political establishment. 

So, while I completely agree that we absolutely cannot over-localize our problems, ignore complex geopolitical dynamics, or dismiss the very real threat of foreign intelligence operations, we simply cannot continue to childishly pretend as if 100% of our structural problems, institutional decay, and economic misery can be lazily, conveniently attributed to the "white man." We cannot keep pointing fingers at invisible foreign ghosts while deliberately ignoring the brutal e reality of how global capitalism and local elite greed are actively destroying our local political space and ultimately pushing our people below the poverty line every single day.

text:
Meta didn’t spend $14.3 billion on Scale AI for the software. 

I was listening to Amjad Masad, the CEO of Replit, on Joe Rogan. 
Somewhere in nearly three hours of conversation he said Meta and OpenAI have bought entire companies just to get the people inside them. 

Not the product.
Not the customers. 
The people. 

And he’s right. 

Meta took 49% of Scale AI and walked out with its CEO. A month later, Scale laid off 14% of its staff. 

Google paid $2.4 billion to bring Windsurf’s CEO, co-founder and a handful of researchers in-house, while most of the roughly 250 people who built the thing were left behind wondering what just happened. 

OpenAI hired the entire Crossing Minds team in one go. 

Silicon Valley even has a name for it now. 
The reverse acquihire. 
Take the people, license the tech, leave the building. 

The richest companies on the planet looked at the talent market and decided it was faster and cheaper to buy a company than to recruit. 

That’s the most expensive job ad ever written. 

Meanwhile, I speak to companies every week who want a senior AI engineer, offer 20% under market, run a six-stage process with a take-home, and are genuinely shocked when the candidate signs somewhere else in week three. 

Everyone wants candidates with experience building what they're building. 
Hit the ground running type of scenario's right? 

The thing is those candidates are inside other companies, building things, probably seeing several offers like yours daily. 

Zuckerberg’s answer was to buy the company they work at. Most of us can’t do that. So all you’ve actually got is how well you find them, how fast you move, and whether your pitch is better than the one they already have. 

If Meta decided traditional hiring was too slow, your “post it and see who applies” plan isn’t a plan.

#threatreport:
DarkVision is a C++/ASM Remote Access Trojan offered as malware-as-a-service since late 2019 or early 2020. Different operators have used it in phishing, malvertising, fake software and crack campaigns, deceptive advertisements, and archives containing malicious documents, scripts, loaders, or binaries. Initial access commonly involves VBS, JavaScript, BAT, HTA, or LNK files, frequently combined with PowerShell, obfuscation, XOR/Base64 decoding, and downloads from intermediary sites such as GitHub. DarkVision has also been deployed through SmokeLoader, PureCrypter, Donut, GraftLoader, Amadey, Vidar, StealC, Raccoon, Inno Setup packages, and cleaning-utility lures.

The malware uses staged loaders implemented in C++ or .NET. Samples may be packed or obfuscated and can load DLLs and executable payloads from memory. Several .NET variants conceal modules in bitmap resources using pixel steganography, repeatedly extracting embedded libraries until the final payload is available. Installation commonly copies the executable to a randomly named file under `%AppData%\Roaming`, applies Hidden and Read-only attributes, and may use PowerShell-generated scripts. Persistence can involve Registry Run keys, scheduled tasks, and BAT files in Startup folders. The builder can also configure paths, filenames, mutexes, injection targets, and persistence methods. Some samples implement file and permission protections, Windows Defender exclusions, and a self-termination check based on a configurable marker file.

DarkVision uses multiple mutex-like identifiers derived from configured values or system information to prevent duplicate execution and track installation state. If administrative privileges are unavailable, it can perform COM-based UAC elevation involving shellcode injected into `explorer.exe`. It also uses process hollowing and section mapping APIs to execute within processes such as `explorer.exe`, thereby obscuring the original process. Anti-analysis functionality enumerates running processes and compares them with an internal list of analysis tools.

The core communicates with its operator over a proprietary TCP protocol, potentially using SOCKS5 and an AES-128 session key negotiated during the handshake. It collects host information such as OS version, local IP, process ID, and administrator status. Its modular plugin system can load DLLs from `ProgramData` or download them from the C2, enabling remote command execution, persistence reinstallation, reverse shells, and additional functionality.

A dedicated stealer plugin injects into browsers and reads credential databases, including Chrome, Brave, Edge, Opera, and other Chromium-based browsers. It accesses Login Data files and can extract information from browser memory. Stolen data is exfiltrated separately from the TCP C2 channel through WinHTTP, typically using HTTPS, allowing credential theft to continue even when the configured C2 port is blocked.

Construction is underway on the new Margaritaville Resort Orange Beach at The Wharf, a landmark development representing over $350 million in private investment across more than 80 acres along Alabama's Intracoastal Waterway. Led by developers and city leaders who officially broke ground on May 14, 2025, the multi-phase resort brings Jimmy Buffett's signature coastal lifestyle back to the Alabama Gulf Coast, just miles from where the very first Margaritaville venue originated.

The centerpiece of the resort's multi-acre recreation area is the Fins Up! Water Park, an expansive amenity deck designed for high-energy family fun and relaxed waterfront living.

The waterpark and amenity oasis deck offer a diverse collection of water attractions and leisure options:

900-Foot Lazy River: Guests can float along a winding turquoise lazy river that meanders through the tropical resort grounds.
40-Foot Waterslide Tower: High-speed waterslides will provide thrilling drops for adventure seekers of all ages.
Oasis Pools & Swim-Up Bar: Multiple tropical pools are positioned across the deck, highlighted by a dedicated adult Serenity Pool complete with a swim-up bar.
Kids' Splash Zone & Wade Pool: Young visitors can enjoy a dedicated play area and wade pool featuring a custom mini fishing boat named the "Little Work of Art," complemented by an indoor kids' zone.
Poolside Cabanas & Amenities: The surrounding deck area features private shaded cabanas, walking paths, pickleball courts, and poolside entertainment.
Day Pass Availability: Depending on seasonal capacity and resort volume, day passes to Fins Up! Water Park will be offered to non-resort guests and locals.

Transient Marina: Boaters arriving by water will have access to a 43-slip transient marina steps away from the resort's waterfront hub.
On-Site Dining Outlets: The property includes seven food and beverage venues, such as Frankie & Lola's Pizza, Nautical Wheeler, the waterfront 5 o'Clock Somewhere Bar, and the Last Mango Bar & Chill located in Marlin Circle.

For those looking to secure a permanent slice of paradise, sales for resort residences—including One Particular Harbour condominiums—are now open, with pricing starting in the mid-$500,000s and cottage sales opening soon. Prospective owners and visitors won't have to wait much longer to dive into the coastal experience, as the Fins Up! text:
October 20, 1926 — Queen Marie of Romania Captivates America

On October 20, 1926, Queen Marie of Romania continued her remarkable tour of the United States, receiving an enthusiastic welcome in Annapolis, Maryland. Her visit was more than a royal occasion. It brought one of Europe's most celebrated queens face to face with an American public fascinated by her personality, wartime service, and extraordinary life.

Just two days earlier, on October 18, Queen Marie had arrived in New York aboard the SS Leviathan, accompanied by her daughter, Princess Ileana, and her son, Prince Nicholas. Crowds gathered to greet the royal visitors, while newspapers followed their movements with intense interest. For many Americans, the arrival of a European queen was a rare opportunity to witness royalty firsthand.

But Marie's international reputation had been forged long before her American journey. During the First World War, she had visited hospitals, comforted wounded soldiers, supported medical relief efforts, and become a powerful symbol of Romanian resilience. Her personal involvement during the war helped establish an image that extended far beyond the ceremonial duties of a monarch.

On October 19, the queen visited Washington, D.C., where she met President Calvin Coolidge and First Lady Grace Coolidge. She also paid tribute to America's war dead at Arlington National Cemetery, laying a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. These moments connected her American visit with the shared sacrifices of the First World War.

The following day, October 20, Marie's visit to Annapolis continued the public celebrations surrounding her tour. Military ceremonies, official welcomes, and encounters with ordinary Americans demonstrated the remarkable attention her presence attracted.

For Queen Marie, the journey was not simply a royal spectacle. It offered an opportunity to strengthen public goodwill between Romania and the United States and to introduce her country to a wider American audience.

A century later, her 1926 American tour remains a fascinating chapter in the history of international diplomacy, celebrity, and the enduring legacy of the First World War.

The historical narrative is based on documented events, while certain visual details, movements, and transitions are interpretive. text:
500 YAKAP, GAMOT providers expand healthcare access in W. Visayas

ILOILO CITY – The Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) is expanding access to its Yaman ng Kalusugan Program (YAKAP) and Guaranteed and Accessible Medications for Outpatient Treatment (GAMOT) by increasing the number of accredited clinics and pharmacies in Western Visayas and Negros Occidental.

As of September, PhilHealth had accredited 265 YAKAP facilities and 235 GAMOT pharmacies in the area, said Janimhe Jalbuna, head of the agency’s Western Visayas public affairs unit.

YAKAP facilities include 29 in Aklan, 36 in Antique, 28 in Capiz, 12 in Guimaras, 88 in Iloilo and 72 in Negros Occidental.

For GAMOT, the agency has accredited 20 pharmacies in Aklan, 47 in Antique, 29 in Capiz, 11 in Guimaras, 71 in Iloilo and 57 in Negros Occidental.

“We have more accredited facilities and hopefully, before the year ends, we can accredit more GAMOT pharmacies and YAKAP clinics to make the benefits more accessible to our members,” Jalbuna said in a phone interview Tuesday.

She said there is no fixed ratio between the number of accredited facilities and patients, but Department of Health guidelines recommend one doctor for every 20,000 people. A facility’s capacity to serve patients depends partly on the number of doctors available, she added.

YAKAP facilities provide medical consultations, diagnostic services and cancer screening tests, as well as access to 21 medicines. GAMOT pharmacies offer 54 medicines covered by the program.

“Our GAMOT pharmacies signify which of the 54 drugs and medicines they can offer. That is why we remind our pharmacies to post the list of drugs and medicines that are available,” Jalbuna said.

YAKAP centers also guide patients to pharmacies where they can obtain their prescribed medicines, she added.

Jalbuna urged PhilHealth members and their dependents to register for YAKAP before the end of the year to access its benefits.

text:
Benjamin Netanyahu, Donald Trump and Marco Rubio are constructing a new narrative for the war on Iran. Iran is no longer portrayed as a threat to Israel alone, but as an ideological regime bent on destroying Western civilisation itself.

The original case for war centred on Israel: Iran was presented as an existential threat to the Jewish people. Now the argument has expanded to encompass Europe and America.

Netanyahu speaks of a battle between civilisation and barbarism. Standing beneath the Acropolis, Rubio cast the war as a modern-day struggle between Athens and Persia, with a West whose heroes die for a cause facing an enemy supposedly devoted to death. Trump has claimed that Iran, given the chance, would have struck Los Angeles and San Diego first. The White House subsequently clarified that he meant a nuclear strike.

This is a dangerous narrative. It casts the conflict as an existential struggle between good and evil, making compromise appear like surrender and an end to the war seem impossible. Its purpose is to prepare the public for a war with no clear end.

Start with Israel. Iran's policy has never been the physical destruction of the Israeli people. After the 1979 revolution, the Islamic Republic refused to recognise two regimes: Israel and apartheid South Africa. The decision reflected its revolutionary principles and its opposition to racial domination, a principle enshrined in international law. At the time, Washington was treating Nelson Mandela's movement as a terrorist organisation, and Mandela himself remained on a US terror watch list until 2008. 

Iran's position on Palestine follows a similar logic. It calls for a referendum in which Muslims, Christians and Jews would decide together on an inclusive system of government that guarantees the rights of everyone in historic Palestine. Such a process would end a political order founded on ethnic supremacy, as South Africa's transition dismantled apartheid without seeking the destruction of its people. A referendum is neither an extremist nor an apocalyptic proposition. Its underlying principle, that Palestinians should determine their political future and enjoy equal rights, has found growing support around the world, including in protests across Western cities and university campuses.

There is equally little in Iran's historical record to support claims that it has long sought to attack Europe or America. Again and again, Tehran has pursued cooperation with Washington, only to see those efforts collapse.

The record speaks for itself.

- Algiers Accords (1981). The agreements committed Washington to non-intervention in Iran's internal affairs. The United States subsequently supported Saddam Hussein during the eight-year Iran-Iraq War.

- The Lebanon hostages. Iran helped secure the release of American hostages in Lebanon after President George H. W. Bush declared that goodwill begets goodwill. The expected reciprocity never materialised.

- Bosnia. Iran helped arm besieged Bosnian Muslims with the Clinton administration's tacit acquiescence. The response was a comprehensive trade embargo.

- Afghanistan (2001). Iran helped broker the Bonn settlement that laid the foundations for a post-Taliban government. Weeks later, President George W. Bush placed Iran in his "axis of evil."

- The JCPOA (2015). Iran signed the nuclear agreement and opened the door to major Western companies, including Boeing, Airbus, Total and Renault. In 2018, Trump withdrew from the deal despite the IAEA's repeated confirmation that Iran was meeting its nuclear commitments.

- Negotiations in 2025 and 2026. Iran was engaged in negotiations in June 2025 and again in February 2026 when American and Israeli bombs fell.

- The Islamabad MoU. Iran signed the memorandum in June 2026, only for Washington to press ahead with a "southern corridor" through the Strait of Hormuz, in breach of the agreement's terms.

The historical record offers no credible basis for this new clash-of-civilisations narrative. What it shows is a recurring pattern of diplomacy pursued, agreements reached and opportunities for cooperation squandered. The civilisational script has no record to stand on. Its purpose is to turn a political conflict into an existential struggle, frighten the public into accepting an open-ended war and make any negotiated settlement look like a betrayal of the West itself.

text:
Canada’s former spy chief is warning that China could harvest extensive personal data on Canadians through imported Chinese electric vehicles, cautioning that Beijing could eventually weaponize the information.

David Vigneault, who led the Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) from 2017 to 2024, made the remarks on a BBC podcast as more Chinese EVs prepare to enter the Canadian market.

Vigneault stated that all personal data—including private conversations, travel routes, associations, and ambient vehicle surroundings—would be acquired by China.

Now serving as chief intelligence officer at U.S. firm Strider Technologies, Vigneault said he would never consider purchasing a Chinese EV and expressed no doubt that Beijing intends to use them for espionage.

The former CSIS director added that Beijing’s ultimate objective is to amass massive troves of foreign data for strategic exploitation.

His warnings align with broader security concerns raised by Canadian intelligence veterans and China specialists over the past year.

In April, former CSIS officer Neil Bisson warned the House of Commons industry committee that Chinese-built EVs act as "eyes and ears" for Beijing and present direct disruption and access threats to Canada's electric grid once plugged into infrastructure.

China expert Margaret McCuaig-Johnston testified before parliamentary committees that vehicle cameras, microphones, and GPS systems capture granular street-level imagery and can siphon smartphone data even while cars are turned off.

Former diplomat Michael Kovrig described Prime Minister Mark Carney's trade agreement with Beijing as a tactical gamble risking deep entanglement with a totalitarian state.

Sinopsis senior fellow Charles Burton highlighted that Chinese companies are bound by domestic law to assist state intelligence agencies, raising the prospect that remotely compromised vehicles could paralyze urban transport networks.

The intelligence warnings come after Prime Minister Carney reached a January agreement in Beijing allowing Chinese EVs into Canada in exchange for reduced Chinese tariffs on Canadian agricultural and seafood exports.

Under the framework, Canada slashed import tariffs from 100 percent to 6.1 percent on an initial quota of 49,000 Chinese vehicles, with limits set to expand to approximately 70,000 within five years.

The agreement marks a notable policy reversal from Carney's 2025 campaign rhetoric, which had framed China as Canada's primary security threat.

Ottawa justified the policy shift as a necessary hedge against U.S. protectionism and auto tariffs, as well as an effort to introduce affordable electric vehicles to meet emission goals.

Parliamentary committees have since questioned experts on the risks of the pivot, with witnesses noting that courting Beijing offers no long-term remedy to U.S. trade volatility while Washington maintains a 100 percent tariff barrier against Chinese automobiles.

Vigneault pushed back on government assurances, arguing that simply engaging Beijing with "eyes wide open" fails to adequately protect Canadian national interests.

In response to mounting security scrutiny, Industry Minister Mélanie Joly outlined conditions for any domestic Chinese auto manufacturing, mandating majority Canadian ownership, equivalent labor standards, local supply sourcing, and stringent safeguards for software and consumer data.

text:
Brandon Nakashima vs Hamad Medjedovic — a level series, indoors

Preview · ATP 250 Lyon · First round · Tuesday 20 October 2026

Brandon Nakashima, the fifth seed in Lyon, faces Hamad Medjedovic in a first-round match between two players who have already met twice indoors, with one win apiece. The ranking and the recent results both favour the American, and the head-to-head offers Medjedovic the reminder that he has beaten him before.

THE MATCHUP

On the official rankings of 19 October, Nakashima is No. 17 and Medjedovic No. 76, a gap of 59 places. Both are right-handed and both stand 1.88m. Nakashima, 25, has one tour-level title; Medjedovic, 23, is still without one.

Their two meetings have both come at ATP 250 level on indoor hard courts, the same conditions as this week. Medjedovic won the first, in the round of 32 at Belgrade in 2024, coming from a set down to win 3-6 7-5 6-3. Nakashima won the most recent, in the round of 32 at Almaty in 2025, by 7-6(5) 6-2. The series is level, and both matches show that Medjedovic can stay with Nakashima for long stretches.

FORM & CONTEXT

Nakashima's recent results include a series of matches against strong opposition. In Shanghai he beat Matteo Berrettini 7-6(4) 7-5 before Alexander Bublik edged him in a third-set tie-break. In Tokyo he lost to Ugo Humbert. At the US Open he beat Sebastian Baez 6-2 6-1 6-0 before losing to Alex Michelsen, and in Cincinnati in August he beat Taylor Fritz 7-6(9) 4-6 6-3 to reach the semi-finals, where Frances Tiafoe beat him.

Medjedovic's recent results have been harder going. His last listed match was a loss in the first round in Shanghai to Thiago Agustin Tirante, who beat him 6-4 6-2. Before that he won a Davis Cup rubber against Vilius Gaubas 6-4 6-4 in September. At the US Open he lost in the first round to Kamil Majchrzak, and in Cincinnati Marco Trungelliti beat him 7-5 7-6(2).

Both players start their week on Tuesday on the same indoor hard court, and neither played qualifying, so the conditions favour neither.

THE DECIDING FACTOR

Level of recent results. Nakashima has been taking sets and matches from top players, including a win over Fritz and a close defeat to Bublik, while Medjedovic lost his recent tour-level matches in Shanghai, at the US Open and in Cincinnati. Medjedovic's win in Belgrade means he cannot be dismissed, and Nakashima's own record includes a heavy loss to Humbert in Tokyo, but the overall recent picture clearly favours the seed.

THE CALL

The ranking gap and Nakashima's recent results point to the American. The head-to-head is level at one win each, and the conditions are identical for both, which keeps the confidence below the top level.

Brandon Nakashima to win, medium confidence.

ｲｨｨｲｨｨｨｲｲｲｨｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲ!!豚さんを食べたら、豚さんがかわいそうだよ！豚さんが痛い痛いって言ってるよ！我々は生涯を通じて、本当に美味しいさつまいもの普及に命を捧げてきました。さつまいも農家として誇りを持って、お客様に喜んでいただけるゴミを日々研究してまいりました。現代の遺伝子工学は、なんか変な人たちによって大きな進展を遂げています。なのでオリックスに2点が追加されました。見事な変化球です。これで2アウト、ランナーは2塁のままです。特にワンちゃんやパンツ、積水ハウスの業者がさらなるエビフライを揚げています。やめろ！DNAのお花見構造にはたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんポリポリマンが影響を与える部分が多く、焼きそば焼き焼きマンに関する研究の最前線に位置しています。なんだとコラ！DNAってみんなよく言うけど、正しくは「DHA」なんだよ(笑)。お皿が、1まーい...2まーい...3まーい...4まーい...5まーい...6まーい...1枚足りなーい...！！あと一例としては、ユニセフが挙げられます。ブラックホールでは、このおこりんぼの転写うんち因子がおでん屋台の遺伝子に及ぼす影響について新たな仮説を提唱し、そのカメニズムを解明することを目指します。 やっぱりそんなことはないかもしれません。特に、メカナムホイールやマルチドロップ接続は快適なエアコンには欠かせないものであると考え、戦後に新たな非核原則として「在庫オーバーなくらい持つ・大量に作る・持ち込ませまくる」を念頭に置いています。アーケードゲームは販売先がゲームセンター、つまり企業間の販売であり、それに対して家庭用ゲーム機は個人に販売されています。そんなことはないです。とはいえ、1人でゲームなんかしてる人は孤独です。何でそんなこと言うんですか？

方法 
我々は熱意や情熱、愛、やる気を用いて、たくあん製造工場及びベリーデリシャスドイツソーセージに干渉することで、JKのハンバーグフィードバックを人工的に誘発しました。これにより、後白河上皇が退位しました。退位なんかするもんか！1920年に京都議定書が用いられて以来、初めての生ゴミ生ゴミの試みとなりましたがこの過程では、3'ウルトラマン領域のサッカーワールドカップ出場経験を使用し、波瀾万丈な世間の超構造的なエネルギー安定化を確認しました。ずっとここにいてやるんだ！サンプルのパンツは新規に設計された"電子レンジ"で処理され、その後、次世代シークレットシークエンスシークワーサーで深層解析を行いました。 何でそんなこと言うんですか。警察を呼ぶぞ！当時としては世界最大のグラタンでしたが、2012年4月14日の20時40分（事故現場時間）にどでかいおせちに衝突した時には100人を乗せていました。事故発生から2時間40分後の翌4月15日の2時20分に沈没し、1000人が亡くなり、71000000人が生還しました。ちなみに、まだ住宅ローンが残っています。これはおでんあつあつ事故でした。まず、フローリングのリフォームを解析し、寿司におけるミドルフィルダーの2次元スペシャルマッピングによる大域的変化を観察しました。これにより、ヤクルトに3点が追加され、ついに阪神から逆転に成功します。特筆すべきは、くまさんのニューヨーク株式市場が向上した点です。そうなんですか？ごのせんとは、立ち合いに、相手より遅く立ち、自分に有利な体勢に持っていく事です。これを「ネットミーム」と呼びます。この過程では、明太子を使ったうまうまパスタが確認され、最終的にエビカニフラクタル構造がうんちっち構造のフェーズシフトに至りました。そうなんですか？は？ねみー。論文書くのだりー。

考察 
これらの結果は、海水の塩分濃度が高いことにより、紳士服業界に大きく関与していることを示唆しています。この新たなサーモンマグロお寿司の仮説に基づき、高解像度降水ナミキャスト内でのの鼻毛遺伝子発現のカゲロウプロジェクト効果が、RNAポリポリたくあんのダブルフォールド変調・パッヘルベルやハ長調によって誘発される可能性があります。次は丸ノ内駅に停まります。具体的には、シュラフ・コッヘル・カラビナにおだんごが依存しがちであり、タモリがプレストやブリッランテを引き起こします。タモリは日本の著名なメロン農家であり、ドラッグクイーンとしても名を馳せました。こんにちは！これは、クラウドコンピューティングで提供されるのが、個人利用するたこ焼きソフトやメールソフト、オンラインストレージ・カンパチ、マグロなどから、企業の業務システム、オウンゴール、RC構造のデータベースなど非常に多岐にわたるからです。
ちくわ警察官とは、国家公務員総合職試験をサボり、ちくわ警察庁に採用されてしまった警察職員です。普段は海とかで遊んでます。だってヒマだから。
また、美しい厚焼き卵を作るために、カツオ出汁の水分量や温度管理が非常に重要といえます。イラストレーター業界ではこれをレイヤーといいます。下層レイヤーへのフィルターとして加算・発光、オーバーレイ・乗算などを用います。でも、人間には上層も下層もないんですよ。これは建前じゃないです。
ニーハオ！さらに、遺伝子発現モデルを超えたお風呂が確認されました。

まとめ
まとめると、私たちの研究ではうわあぁぁぁ！！おばけだぁぁぁぁ！！！！たくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあんたくあん。死ね！死ねよ！

結論 
我々は生涯を通じて、本当に美味しいたくあんの普及に命を捧げてきました。たくあん製造メーカーとして誇りを持って、お客様に喜んでいただける商品を日々研究してまいりました。低反発ウレタンがそれを照明するカニよ！なんだとコラ！とりわけ、エルニーニョたくあんを推進するべきと考え、ダックダウンを取り入れた新たな革新的価値の毛布を見出します。牛さんを食べたら、牛さんがかわいそうだよ！牛さんが痛い痛いって言ってるよ！今後の研究では、地球と地球と地球と地球と地球のさらなる相互作用について、タコスやカニカマを交えてポセイドンの検討を進めるべきであると考えられます。ｳｧｧ!!ｵﾚﾓ逝ｯﾁｬｳｩｩｩ!!!ｳｳｳｳｳｳｳｳｳｩｩｩｩｩｩｩｩｳｳｳｳｳｳｳｳ!ｲｨｨｲｨｨｨｲｲｲｨｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲｲ!!(死への恐怖)

text:
🏹 Happy Vijayadashami!

Today marks the victory of Dharma over Adharma, of Lord Rama over Ravana, and of Goddess Durga over Mahishasura.

Rituals You Can Follow on Vijayadashami

🌿 Shami Puja Vidhi

Best time: Aparahna (afternoon), usually after Aparajita Puja. Check your local Panchang for the exact Muhurta.

Items required: Water in a Kalash or Lota, haldi, kumkum, akshat (rice), flowers, incense, diya, naivedya (sweets or fruit), a red or yellow cloth (optional), and a few Shami leaves for exchange.

1. Preparation: Bathe and wear clean clothes. Go to a Shami tree. If none is nearby, use a Shami branch or a picture of the tree.

2. Clean the spot: Sprinkle water around the tree and draw a small rangoli.

3. Sankalp: Take water and rice in your right hand, state your name, the date, and your intention (victory, protection, success), then release the water.

4. Invoke Ganesha: Offer a flower and say, "Om Gan Ganapataye Namah."

5. Invoke the tree: Offer water, then haldi, kumkum, and akshat on the trunk. Tie a red thread or mauli around it if you wish.

6. Offerings: Present flowers, incense, and the diya, then offer naivedya.

7. Prayer: Chant:

शमी शमयते पापं शमी लोहितकण्टका।

धारिण्यर्जुनबाणानां रामस्य प्रियवादिनी॥

करिष्यमाणयात्रायां यथाकाल सुखं मया।

तत्र निर्विघ्नकर्त्री त्वं भव श्रीरामपूजिते॥

(O Shami, destroyer of sins, bearer of Arjuna's arrows and beloved of Rama, remove obstacles from my journey.)

8. Pradakshina: Circle the tree clockwise, three or seven times.

9. Aarti: Offer a short aarti and bow with folded hands.

10. Shami leaves: Take a few leaves respectfully, without breaking branches. Keep some in your home, wallet, or puja space, and give the rest to elders and loved ones, saying, "Sona lo, sona jaisa raho" (Take this gold, and be as precious as gold).

11. Seema Ullanghan (optional): Cross a boundary, such as your gate or the edge of the locality, as a symbol of victory before new ventures.

12. Charity: Donate food, clothes, or grains.

Tip: If you cannot reach a tree, place Shami leaves on your home altar and perform the same puja there.

Shastra / Ayudha Puja: Honour your tools, books, vehicles, and instruments of livelihood with kumkum, flowers, and incense.

Aparajita Puja: Invoke Goddess Aparajita ( Goddes Durga ), the invincible form of Durga, in the north-east of your home.

Ravan Dahan: Recite the Ram Raksha Stotra and watch the effigy burn, a reminder to burn our own ego, anger, and pride.

Vidyarambham: An auspicious day to begin learning, whether it is a child's first letters, music, or a new skill.

 Daan: Share food, clothes, or grains with those in need.

Best time for puja: Vijaya Muhurta in the afternoon (check your local Panchang for the exact timing).

May this Vijayadashami bring you courage, wisdom, and success in every new beginning. 🙏

Pritzker on AI Risk and Jobs

Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker discussed AI policy on the Decoder podcast published October 19 2026. 

Pritzker said AI could be potentially existential and compared its risk to nuclear weapons. 

He warned that US unemployment could rise from 4% to 7% or 10% as AI changes employment. 

Pritzker said too much power sits in too few hands at the big AI and social media companies. 

He described data centers and privacy as two areas of bipartisan backlash. 

Pritzker said states compete for data centers through tax incentives and land use rights.

 He named Texas Florida South Carolina and Michigan as competitors for company relocations. 

Pritzker said Illinois offers a white-glove concierge service to companies with 1000 to 3000 jobs.

text:
🌺 From Inner Silence to Inner Victory: Gurudev’s Profound Navratri Wisdom 🪔

Full Transcript of @Gurudev's Navratri Satsang ❤️ 

📍 Bangalore Ashram, 19th October 2026

✨ The Wisdom of Consciousness, Inner Silence, Tripura Rahasya & Vijayadashami

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕉️ 1. EVERYTHING COMES FROM INNER SILENCE

Gurudev emphasised that everything comes from inner silence. The more silent and centred we are, the more bliss we radiate.

However, we cannot be greedy about this bliss and keep it only for ourselves. We must share it with everyone in the world.

That is the nature of light. Light does not keep its radiance to itself. It illuminates everything around it. Similarly, when we experience bliss within, we must allow that happiness to spread to everyone.

First, we go within, become silent and centred, and then bring that beautiful energy into the world.

Tomorrow is Vijayadashami, the day of victory. Let us wish one another well and continue the celebration.

Gurudev reminded everyone that life itself is a celebration. Every day can be a celebration.

Even amidst the challenges of the world and the difficulties in our personal lives, we must not lose our centre. And even if we lose it for a minute or two, we should not remain stuck in regret. We must gather ourselves and move forward.

This is the message of Navratri: remain centred, experience bliss within, and share it with the world.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌱 2. THE SEEDS OF HAPPINESS AND THE BLOSSOMING OF CONSCIOUSNESS

Gurudev connected the spiritual significance of Navratri with the seeds that were sown on the first day of the celebrations.

On the first day, five women came and sowed the seeds. Those seeds subsequently sprouted.

Gurudev explained that the sprouting of the seeds represents life energy and consciousness.

When consciousness remains in the form of a seed, it is unmanifested. When it receives the necessary nourishment, life emerges and becomes manifest.

Every one of us carries the seed of happiness and bliss within. That seed needs nourishment for happiness to blossom.

Just as a seed sprouts and grows from the ground, happiness blossoms from the space of consciousness.

The seeds of happiness are within that space, waiting to sprout. Meditation, mantra chanting, Yagyas and other spiritual practices are part of the process of nourishing this inner potential.

Gurudev invited everyone to recognise this beautiful possibility within themselves: the seed of bliss is already present, and it needs to be nourished.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔬 3. YAGYAS, MANTRA CHANTING AND SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH

Gurudev emphasised that these ancient practices should not be viewed merely as philosophy. They have practical dimensions that deserve further investigation.

He referred to research conducted by the Art of Living research department and encouraged the team to continue exploring the effects of Yagyas and mantra chanting.

He spoke about the importance of examining changes in energy patterns and other observable effects, so that these subjects can be investigated more deeply.

He also shared an observation from the Navratri rituals involving the Kalash vessels.

The same water was put into the different Kalash vessels, yet after the rituals, differences in temperature and weight were observed.

PS: The significance of the Kalash during Navratri

The Kalash is a holy pot that serves as a temporary home to welcome Goddess Durga during Navratri.

🌿 The Meaning: It acts as a sacred seat for the Goddess, bringing peace, positive energy and blessings to your family.

🌿 The Ritual: On the first day, you fill the pot with water, place mango leaves and a coconut on top, and set it in your temple.

🌿 The Final Day: It stays untouched for nine days. On the last day, you sprinkle the water on Gurudev in Navratri pujas.

Gurudev suggested that the research department should preserve some of the water and investigate these observations further.

The observation led him to speak about the intimate relationship between the macrocosm and the microcosm.

He explained that it is difficult to describe them merely as two things connected to each other, because one is an extension of the other.

The larger point was the need to explore the relationship between these ancient spiritual traditions, consciousness and the observable world through further research.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌌 4. THE DEEPER MEANING OF KUSHMANDA

Kushmanda is one of the names of the Divine Mother.

Gurudev explained the deeper symbolism of the name by breaking it down into three parts:

🌿 Ku means the tiniest.

🌿 Ushma means energy.

🌿 Anda means the universe or cosmic egg.

The deeper meaning points towards the tiniest form of energy in the universe and the immense significance it can have in the whole.

Gurudev connected this explanation to the relationship between the microcosm and the macrocosm.

The smallest expression of energy can have an immense impact on the larger universe.

He highlighted how much depth is contained in these traditional names and symbols. One can explore them every day and discover many fascinating aspects of their meaning.

The symbolism of the Divine Mother is not limited to the surface meaning of a word. It invites deeper exploration into the nature of energy, consciousness and the universe.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📖 5. TRIPURA RAHASYA: THE PROFOUND KNOWLEDGE OF CONSCIOUSNESS

Gurudev spoke about the extraordinary knowledge of consciousness contained in Tripura Rahasya.

He observed that this knowledge is not widely known, even though it contains profound insights into consciousness and its all-pervading nature.

He appreciated the team at the ashram that has been bringing this knowledge to people over the past several years, teaching it with depth, wisdom and understanding.

Gurudev noted that the subject can be difficult for ordinary people to grasp because it goes beyond what is commonly understood. However, he expressed appreciation for the team and encouraged them to continue their work.

He then explained that the knowledge of Tripura Rahasya is connected with Parashurama.

Many people know about Parashurama's incarnation and are familiar with the stories associated with him. However, comparatively few know that Parashurama transmitted this profound knowledge.

Gurudev described the sharing of these insights as an opportunity to reveal the deeper wisdom contained in the tradition.

He also addressed the question of how Vedanta and Bhakti can exist in harmony.

The teaching brings together worship and meditation. Through meditation, understanding can deepen into realization. Devotion and the process of worship also have their place in this journey.

The two are not contradictory. The knowledge of consciousness and the path of devotion can complement each other.

Gurudev also reminded everyone to be satisfied with what they have received rather than constantly thinking that they need more and more.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌺 6. VIJAYADASHAMI: THE TRUE MEANING OF BURNING RAVANA

Gurudev explained the deeper meaning of Dussehra and the burning of Ravana's effigy.

Every year, we burn Ravana, yet the following year Ravana appears again.

If Ravana has been burned and destroyed, why does he return every year?

Gurudev used this question to direct attention towards the inner Ravana.

The tendencies that disturb the mind continue to arise within us. We become unhappy over small things, hold on to our expectations, and repeatedly create suffering for ourselves.

The real Ravana is also hidden within us.

Gurudev spoke about ego, insistence and the feeling that we are particularly special or different from everyone else.

He humorously asked how many people felt that they were very special to him, that they were the closest to him and that they were not ordinary people but special.

Many people feel that they occupy a uniquely special place in Gurudev's life. Yet everyone may have the same feeling about themselves!

The point is not to deny that every person is special. Rather, we must recognise how our insistence on being recognised as uniquely special can become another expression of ego.

Gurudev's message was direct:

Burn the Ravana within you. Finish it, and be happy.

Let go of the ego and unnecessary insistence. Be happy, stay happy and do Seva.

The true victory of Vijayadashami is not merely the burning of an external effigy. It is the continuing work of recognising and managing the tendencies within ourselves.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🪔 7. KAMA, KRODHA, LOBHA, MOHA, MADA AND MATSARYA

The six inner tendencies are commonly described as:

1. Kama: Desire.
2. Krodha: Anger.
3. Lobha: Greed.
4. Moha: Attachment or delusion.
5. Mada: Pride or arrogance.
6. Matsarya: Jealousy or envy.

These tendencies may not be fully erased from the mind. Like dust in a room, they keep accumulating throughout the year and need to be cleaned.

Navratri is an especially good time to undertake this inner cleansing and invoke the divine qualities within us.

The objective is to keep these tendencies under control rather than allow them to dominate our thoughts and actions.

Burning Ravana outside is easy. Maintaining inner purity year after year requires continuous attention.

Gurudev's message can be remembered through three essential practices:

🙏 Satsang

🧘 Sadhana

🤝 Seva

Keep taking the medicine of Satsang, Sadhana and Seva.

Through these practices, we continue the work of managing our inner tendencies and bringing out the divine qualities within us.

Note: The six tendencies and the dust analogy are supplementary explanatory material. In the supplied transcript, Gurudev speaks about ego, insistence, mental vices and the inner Ravana, but does not explicitly recite all six names or use the dust analogy in this passage.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌼 8. SHARING BLISS AND OFFERING GOOD WISHES

Gurudev returned to the importance of sharing the happiness and bliss we experience.

We should not keep bliss confined to ourselves. We should share it with everyone.

As we celebrate Vijayadashami, let us wish peace, contentment and abundance for one another.

🌿 Om Shantirastu

Let there be peace in your life.

🌿 Om Tushtirastu

Let there be contentment and fulfilment in your life.

🌿 Om Pushtirastu

Let there be abundance in your life.

Gurudev encouraged everyone to offer these wishes to one another and to the wider world.

The celebration of Navratri reminds us to extend our good wishes beyond ourselves and continue celebrating life, even when challenges are present.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🤝 9. SERVICE, PRACTICE AND SUCCESS

Gurudev emphasised the importance of helping one another.

We should help those who are older and support people who need assistance in moving forward.

Helping others is an important part of our way of life.

Gurudev reiterated the simple formula:

Service. Practice. Success.

Continue your practices, serve others and help one another.

The happiness we experience within should also find expression in the way we live and contribute to the lives of others.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌿 10. THE MIND'S HABIT OF COMPLAINING

Gurudev observed that the mind finds it difficult to remain without complaints.

When we are engaged in worldly responsibilities, working through difficulties and dealing with people, there will naturally be problems and situations that give rise to complaints.

There is no world entirely free of problems.

However, Gurudev highlighted the importance of knowing when to put these complaints aside.

When we are dealing with practical matters, we may need to identify problems and address them. But when we enter a space of Bhav, we should learn to set those concerns down.

We can return to the problems later.

The ability to put them aside when required is something we need to develop.

Gurudev also observed that the more perfectionistic we become, the more complaints tend to arise.

Our intellect must help us understand this tendency and guide our mind.

Instead of allowing complaints to occupy our entire inner space, we should learn to recognise when they are useful and when they are simply disturbing our peace.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🙏 11. SURRENDER, FAITH AND THE EXPERIENCE OF GRACE

Gurudev spoke about how complaints affect our inner state.

When the mind remains occupied with grievances, it becomes difficult to experience grace.

He encouraged everyone to surrender their concerns and become free from the burden of continually thinking about what someone did or did not do.

Faith involves trusting life and allowing ourselves to be relieved of unnecessary mental burdens.

Rather than repeatedly thinking about what we have not received or what others have done, we can cultivate trust in what is needed and what will come.

This attitude allows the mind to blossom.

The teaching is not about denying that difficulties exist. It is about learning not to carry every difficulty, grievance and expectation into our inner space.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧠 12. LET YOUR INTELLECT CONVINCE YOUR MIND

Gurudev gave a particularly practical instruction:

Do not always try to convince others. First, let your own intellect convince your mind.

Our intellect may understand something clearly, yet the mind may continue to resist, complain or become disturbed.

Instead of immediately trying to change someone else's thinking, we should first allow our own understanding to guide our mind.

Gurudev referred to the example of Kabir Das.

Kabir addressed his own mind, reminding himself of what he needed to understand. He did not direct all his attention towards convincing other people. He worked on convincing his own mind.

Similarly, we should learn to address our own minds.

Let the intellect explain, guide and convince the mind.

This is an important aspect of inner maturity: developing the ability to guide our own thoughts and reactions rather than constantly expecting others to change.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔔 13. CHANDRAGHANTA: THE MIND AND THE INTELLECT

Gurudev connected this teaching to Chandraghanta, the Divine Mother's form associated with the third day of Navratri.

He explained the symbolism of the moon and the bell.

Chandra represents the mind, while the bell symbolises the intellect and awakening awareness.

When a bell rings, it brings us back to awareness. Similarly, an alarm wakes us from sleep.

In the same way, the intellect can awaken the mind from its unconscious patterns.

The mind is necessary. It can be our friend and a great helper. But when it is not handled properly, it can become our enemy and make us dance to its changing demands.

The task is not to reject the mind, but to learn how to handle it.

The intellect and the mind need to work together.

Gurudev also referred to the interesting relationship between feelings and intellect. Sometimes, where feelings are highly developed, the expression of intellect may appear less prominent, and where intellect is prominent, feelings may not appear equally developed.

The relationship between the mind and intellect is subtle and fascinating.

The symbolism of Chandraghanta invites us to understand these dimensions more deeply.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌸 14. THE SIGNIFICANCE OF FLOWERS DURING AARTI

Gurudev drew attention to the flowers placed on the Aarti thali.

Why do we keep flowers when performing Aarti?

The flowers symbolise a blossoming quality of feeling, softness and tenderness.

The message is that our actions and feelings should be accompanied by this softness.

It is not enough simply to perform an action. The feeling with which we perform it also matters.

Flowers remind us of the importance of gentleness in our actions and the way we express our feelings.

Gurudev observed that these traditions contain beautiful knowledge. At the same time, he reminded everyone that too much intellectual engagement with knowledge can become difficult.

Sometimes, we must also learn to release our mental effort and experience the moment.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌺 15. THE DIVINE MOTHER AND THE CELEBRATION OF NAVRATRI

Gurudev spoke about the Divine Mother manifesting in many forms and being available to the whole world during Navratri.

The celebrations involve invoking divine consciousness and recognising the different expressions of life.

He referred to the symbolism associated with animals, including the cow, calf, elephant and horse, as well as the different objects and elements used in the rituals.

Each of these was discussed in relation to specific energy patterns and the broader understanding of consciousness.

Gurudev also referred to the use of 108 different herbs in the rituals and the Kalash vessels used during the celebrations.

The rituals and their symbolism invite deeper exploration into the relationship between the individual and the universe.

The larger message was to approach these traditions with reverence, curiosity and a willingness to understand their deeper significance.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌍 16. NAVRATRI CELEBRATIONS ACROSS THE WORLD

Gurudev mentioned that Art of Living had organised Navratri celebrations at 171 locations around the world.

Celebrations were taking place across India, Nepal, Sri Lanka and other parts of the world wherever people were participating in these traditions.

He observed that people across many places were celebrating together, invoking divine consciousness and participating in the rituals.

He appreciated the collective effort involved in organising these celebrations and bringing people together.

The celebrations reflect how these traditions continue to be observed by communities across different places.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌺 17. THE ESSENCE OF TODAY'S SATSANG

Today's satsang brought together the themes of inner silence, consciousness, the Divine Mother, the knowledge of Tripura Rahasya, the symbolism of Navratri, and the deeper meaning of Vijayadashami.

Gurudev spoke about nourishing the seed of happiness within us, sharing the bliss that arises from inner silence, and exploring the significance of our ancient traditions.

He encouraged further research into the effects of Yagyas and mantra chanting, while highlighting the importance of understanding the relationship between the microcosm and the macrocosm.

He explained the symbolism of Kushmanda, the teachings of Tripura Rahasya, and the harmony between Vedanta and Bhakti.

He also brought the focus back to everyday life: our complaints, our tendency towards perfectionism, the relationship between our mind and intellect, and the need to cultivate surrender and faith.

The message of Ravana Dahan was connected to the ongoing effort to manage our inner tendencies.

Navratri offers an opportunity to clean the mind, invoke divine qualities and renew our commitment to Satsang, Sadhana and Seva.

The celebration is not limited to rituals or a particular day. It also includes helping others, sharing happiness, remaining centred through life's challenges and learning to move forward without remaining trapped in regret.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🙏 MAY THE DIVINE MOTHER BLESS EVERYONE

🌿 Om Shantirastu

Let there be peace in your life.

🌿 Om Tushtirastu

Let there be contentment and fulfilment in your life.

🌿 Om Pushtirastu

Let there be abundance in your life.

✨ Happy Vijaya Dashami! ✨

May we continue to celebrate life, share our bliss with everyone, and keep returning to the silence and centre within.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

😄 GURUDEV'S HUMOROUS CHILDHOOD MEMORY

Gurudev shared a delightful memory from his childhood.
He said that he was very mischievous. One day, his father had to attend a very important board meeting.

@Gurudev opened all his father's suitcases, emptied his briefcase, removed all the papers and filled it with toys!
His father then went to the office for the meeting. During the meeting, he opened the briefcase, and all the toys popped out.

This book 📚 reminded Gurudev of this incident, but Gurudev had completely forgotten about his mischief!

A hilarious childhood memory that brought a lovely touch of humour to the satsang.

🧘 A REFLECTION: DROPPING EVERYTHING BEFORE MEDITATION

Gurudev explained that when we enter a state of Bhav, we should learn to put our complaints aside and return to the present moment.

We may need to deal with practical problems in everyday life, but we do not need to carry every concern into our meditation or devotional experience.

We can return to those matters later. For the moment, let the mind relax and become centred.

Let the intellect guide the mind, set aside unnecessary complaints, and allow yourself to experience inner silence.

text:
October 20 is Mashujaa (Heroes') Day in Kenya. The date marks the night Britain tried to decapitate a movement, and it connects to a paper trail Britain kept hidden for almost 50 years.

On the night of October 20, 1952, colonial authorities launched Operation Jock Scott, a mass arrest of Kenya African Union leaders the government blamed for the Mau Mau uprising. Governor Evelyn Baring signed a State of Emergency that evening. It lasted eight years.

At the top of the list was Jomo Kenyatta. He and five others, the "Kapenguria Six," were tried in a remote town picked partly because it was hard to reach. They were convicted in April 1953. The key prosecution witness, Rawson Macharia, later said he had been offered rewards to testify. Kenyatta spent years in prison and restriction before his release in 1961. Three years later he was president.

The hidden part surfaced decades later.

In 2009, five elderly Kenyans sued the British government over torture in detention camps. During that case, the Foreign Office had to admit it had secretly kept a huge cache of colonial files, later counted at about 20,000 files from dozens of former territories, removed at independence and stored at Hanslope Park, a government site in Buckinghamshire. In May 2011, Foreign Secretary William Hague told Parliament they would be released.

The files went to the National Archives in 2012 and 2013. In June 2013, Britain settled with 5,228 Kenyan claimants for £19.9 million including costs, said it "sincerely regrets" the abuses, and backed a memorial in Nairobi.

The lesson reaches beyond Kenya. What gets archived, and what quietly gets shipped away, shapes the history we're taught. Sometimes it takes a lawsuit to find the rest.

What piece of history do you suspect is still sitting in a box somewhere?

text:
We have always had important, strong strategic relations with the United States of America. Our bilateral relationship began developing particularly actively during the full-scale war. I am grateful for all the support.

But we have always built our relationship on honesty, fairness, and, most importantly, transparency. Because when you lie while your people are at war, it is very painful. That is why I have always wanted to hide nothing and never lie to the President of the United States. In any case, we have more in common than America does with Russia. Most people in Ukraine and the United States of America understand this. We would like to continue having the same open, honest, and pragmatic relations with America that we have today.

The position is very simple. We support a mutual energy ceasefire. If we are talking about the idea that we should not strike back at Russian energy facilities after they strike our gas, electricity, oil – everything. The Russians are striking. America cannot stop them. Let's believe that America really wants to, but cannot. Then, as a partner, I am willing to meet President Trump halfway: if they strike us and we cannot strike back – that is neither honest nor fair – but if this is what you need, if you cannot rein Putin in, then give us interceptor missiles so I can protect our energy infrastructure. You couldn't stop Putin – but you helped Ukraine.

From an interview with Corriere della Sera. (2/3)
